The activity requests analysis of safety incidents and trends across manufacturing sites. None of the candidates directly support this capability:

- The agents (AccessProvisioningOrchestrator, AssetProvisioningOrchestrator, ChangeAutomationOrchestrator, ChangeReleaseCoordinator, ProductLifecycleOrchestrator, ProductionChangeOrchestrator) focus on orchestrating provisioning, changes, and releases—not on analyzing safety data or incidents.
- The dataProducts (ProductChangeAndInventoryAnalytics, ProductImpactSalesIntelligence) aggregate engineering changes, materials, and inventory metrics for optimization purposes, not safety incident analysis.

While these candidates are tangentially related to manufacturing operations, none actually provides the safety incident analysis and trending capability the activity describes.
